fields.name: page
fields.description: Pagination & sorting: {page, pageSize, orders[]}

fields.name: page.page
fields.description: Page number, starting from 1, default 1

fields.name: page.pageSize
fields.description: Items per page, default 20

fields.name: page.orders
fields.description: Sort rules, elements {field, direction}; direction takes DESC (descending) / ASC (ascending). field is a metric field in the response (e.g., sales, revenue, price, reviewRating, reviewCount, salesRate)

fields.name: skus
fields.description: SKU array (max 10), for precise lookup of specified products

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Keyword array, filters by product title

fields.name: categoryIds
fields.description: Category ID array (Nexscope category IDs, not category names)

fields.name: sellerName
fields.description: Seller name array

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand filter: {brandName: array<string>, type: integer}; type takes 0 include brand, 1 exclude brand, 2 unbranded

fields.name: fulfillment
fields.description: Fulfillment method array, fixed options: OZON, FBO, FBS, RFBS, FBP

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Label array, fixed options: 0 new product, 1 genuine product, 2 best seller

fields.name: creationDate
fields.description: Listing time filter (months), fixed options: 1 last 30 days, 3 last 90 days, 6 last 180 days, 12 last year, 24 last two years; no filtering if omitted

fields.name: variationsMerge
fields.description: Whether to merge variants: 0 do not merge, 1 merge

fields.name: searchDate
fields.description: Query date yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2026-04-01); defaults to last 30 days if omitted; passing 2026-04-01 queries March 2026 data

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag word

fields.name: uId
fields.description: User ID

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Member ID (a unique member identifier; data is attributed to memberId)

fields.name: monthlySales
fields.description: Monthly sales range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: monthlySalesRate
fields.description: Sales growth-rate range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: monthlyRevenue
fields.description: Monthly revenue range in RUB: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: price
fields.description: Price range in RUB: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: convToCartPdp
fields.description: Cart conversion-rate range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: reviewRating
fields.description: Rating range from 0 to 5: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: reviewCount
fields.description: Review-count range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: questionsAndAnswers
fields.description: Question-and-answer count range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: variants
fields.description: Variant-count range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: drr
fields.description: Advertising cost-share range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: grossMargin
fields.description: Gross-margin range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: returnCancellationRate
fields.description: Return and cancellation-rate range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: weight
fields.description: Weight range in grams: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fields.name: volume
fields.description: Volume range in liters: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted
